facts.value: Coordinates a two-cadence controller scheduler and periodic raw-input/card service callback, plus reset and delegated disc/card maintenance. Requested intervals are staged separately from effective alarm timing; game/copy status publication uses cadence 0.

facts.value: Initialization invokes the callback before resetting state and arms the nominal periodic service. Reconfiguration itself does not mask interrupts; the queue-count wrapper calls it under masking, while initialization calls it directly. Shutdown masks interrupts and clears only the active marker. Repeated initialization clears that marker without cancelling an existing alarm. After shutdown, unchanged requested/effective timing causes reconfiguration to return without rearming. Each cadence advancement subtracts at most one interval and overwrites its due flag, which persists until another advancement.
facts.rationale: Correct lifecycle invariants against all local call paths and early returns.

evidence.why: Early-return/rearm guards and absence of local masking.
Masked wrapper.
Flag lifetime, shutdown and initialization.

facts.value: Every call overwrites both due flags after adding the effective period to each accumulator. A reached threshold causes exactly one interval subtraction; there is no catch-up loop. facts.rationale: Use exact local arithmetic and type conversion.
